feature_report.description: Each quantum_expZ_qubit{i} feature is the EXACT expectation value of the Pauli-Z observable on qubit i, after that qubit's PCA-encoded input has passed through the trainable ansatz and linear entangling layer. It is not claimed to represent any specific clinical or physical quantity beyond this literal definition -- it is a learned, entangled nonlinear transform of the 4 PCA features, in [-1, 1].
